1.consolidated_definition: Ave de hasta 40 cm de altura, de cuerpo muy esbelto, pico negro, largo y recto, larguísimas patas rosadas, zona dorsal negra, frente, corona, región ventral y cola blancas. Recurvirostridae; Himantopus mexicanus.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Bird of up to 40 cm in height, with a very slender body, black, long, and straight beak, extremely long pink legs, black dorsal zone, white forehead, crown, ventral region, and tail. Recurvirostridae; Himantopus mexicanus.

2.en_consolidated_definition: Scabiosa maritima is a small plant with purple flowers that grow in spikes and has a short lifespan.
